name: brief-note
description: A short Markdown instruction file (such as CLAUDE.md) drawn as a page: its file name, a top heading and sections of short lines; any section can be lit, marked new, dimmed or flagged as not belonging.

file.description: the file name in the header

badge.description: a chip in the header, e.g. `draft` or `re-read from disk`

state.description: lit: the point of this step; new: just added; dim: not relevant now; waste: doesn't belong here

note.description: a short note at the right of the heading

sections.heading: What this folder is
lines: Monthly sales reports for Acme, built from CSV exports.
